name: thesis-mcwm-headway-alignment-v16
interpretation: Same-vehicle next-station headway transitions and the continuous tanh penalty from sumo-rl commit 3416538. Preserve current dual actions, global event-batch observations, fixed reward scale 0.01 and gradient limit 10. Train new IQL initializers because the transition contract changed. Both MC variants learn the next current-slot index and preserve the known same-vehicle line invariant. They differ only in state-reconstructed versus target-fit raw reward prediction. Passenger rewards and old datasets remain unchanged. This is a development repair, not a literal rerun of the historical online-SUMO SAC ensemble.
